name: High Visibility Fluorescent Reflective Safety Jacket with Multi-Pockets
shortDescription: EN ISO 20471 Class 2 fluorescent neon polyester safety vest with 2-inch wide 360° reflective micro-prismatic bands, heavy front zipper, and ID card pocket.
overview: Essential for 24/7 worker visibility in busy traffic zones, railway lines, airport aprons, and dark construction sites, this high-visibility safety vest guarantees instant visual recognition from all angles. Manufactured from lightweight, breathable 120 GSM fluorescent neon polyester fabric, it features two horizontal and two vertical 2-inch wide retro-reflective bands that catch headlights from over 300 meters away. It features a rugged front resin zipper closure, reinforced black edge piping, a transparent PVC pocket for ID cards, two large cargo utility pockets, and dedicated pen slots.
keyFeatures: Certified to EN ISO 20471 Class 2 and ANSI/ISEA 107-2015 high-visibility standards
High-reflectivity 2-inch micro-prismatic silver reflective tape with 360° coverage
Lightweight, breathable 120 GSM fluorescent polyester warp-knit fabric
Heavy-duty front zipper closure ensures secure fit without flapping in high winds
Multi-functional utility pocket layout: Clear ID badge pocket, radio strap, pen slots, and cargo flaps
Durable black edge binding prevents fraying and keeps jacket looking clean
Machine washable with reflective properties maintained over 25+ wash cycles
